label: UNVALIDATED SAMPLE OUTPUT
title: Where in-game DB turns happen (30–90 yd in 5-yd buckets)
claim: Descriptive locations of valid DB game turns in the direction-normalised field frame. Not a report figure.
caveats: PLACEHOLDER_SAMPLE: a FULL version needs the full game tracking CSVs plus player_play.csv, which are not on this machine; the FULL turn table carries no x_centre/y_centre.
Only the 30-90 yd window is bucketed: 75 turns below 30 yd and 442 above 90 yd are counted in the manifest but not drawn.
Exploratory: not one of the four report figures (D189); the writeup does not cite it.

coordinate_frame.x: x = distance from the offence's own goal line (yd), direction-normalised
coordinate_frame.mirror_rule: play_direction == 'left': x -> 120 - x, y -> 53.3 - y; play_direction == 'right': unchanged
coordinate_frame.evidence: 46% of matched sample plays have median vx < 0; raw x is not canonical per play direction

full_data_caveat: PLACEHOLDER_SAMPLE. The FULL turn table has no x_centre/y_centre and the full game tracking CSVs are not on this machine. A FULL version needs those tracking files plus play_direction, and a re-render through this same script.
